preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 100000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(s, str) and 1 <= len(s) <= 100000 and all(c in 'ANTO' for c in s) for s in testcases)
preconditions.description: Each test case string consists only of characters 'A', 'N', 'T', 'O' and has length between 1 and 100000.
The sum of lengths of all test case strings does not exceed 100000.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly t lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(sorted(output_lines[i]) == sorted(testcases[i]) for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: Each output string is a permutation of the corresponding input string.

postconditions.expression: all(inversions(output_lines[i], testcases[i]) == max(inversions(p, testcases[i]) for p in permutations(testcases[i])) for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output string maximizes the number of swaps (inversions) required to transform it back to the original string, which corresponds to the maximum time for Anton's body to revert the DNA.
